sources.title: Someone Fine-Tuned OpenBMB's MiniCPM5-1B on Claude Fable 5 Traces to Ship a 657MB Local Thinking Model - MarkTechPost
sources.snippet: The GGUF card gives a one-line path through Ollama: ... The same repository documents llama.cpp, LM Studio, jan, and KoboldCpp. Recommended sampling for Think mode is temperature=0.9, top_p=0.95. The model may emit reasoning blocks before the final answer, which downstream apps can strip. The model is a supervised fine-tune of OpenBMB’s MiniCPM5-1B on Claude Fable 5 traces, not a weight-level distillation.

sources.title: MiniCPM5-2B GGUF: How Does It Hold Up Locally? | MindStudio
sources.snippet: MiniCPM5-2B-GGUF is a converted and quantized version of the same weights (offered in F16, Q8_0, and Q4_K_M) built specifically to run in llama.cpp, Ollama, and LM Studio on consumer hardware.
